channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Who is Santosh Janardhan? What's ahead for Meta after departure of long-time infrastructure head in 2027?
item.description: Santosh Janardhan, Meta Platform's long-time head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering, will leave the tech giant in early 2027. Current vice president of infrastructure Dave Brown will suceed.&nbsp;

item.title: Aamir Khan Productions, Farhan Akhtar's Excel Entertainment team up for microdrama platform: What to expect
item.description: Aamir Khan Productions and Excel Entertainment are partnering to launch a microdrama platform in India. The venture will combine their existing content libraries with original productions and digital creator partnerships, with a telecom partner supporting distribution.

item.title: Meet Omni Bridgeway, the litigation funder eyeing up to a $260 million windfall from Tata Power arbitration award
item.description: The Sydney-listed litigation financier bankrolled Kleros Capital’s $6.4 million legal battle against Tata Power—and could walk away with a 40x return if Singapore’s apex court upholds the award.

item.title: ‘I’m a piece of sh--’: Inside Jensen Huang’s final hours as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Jensen Huang spent decades building Nvidia into a multi-trillion-dollar AI chip behemoth. Now, in the eyes of the people in the room, he had given up.

item.title: ‘Whatever', ‘I don’t care’, ‘I’m a piece of sh—’: Jensen Huang's last hours at Nvidia were filled with despair | Report
item.description: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO after admitting to an extramarital affair and facing allegations involving a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. His final hours at the company were filled with despair, according to a report.

item.title: Microsoft Outlook outage: Efforts underway to restore Outlook, Teams and Copilot; when will services return?
item.description: Microsoft is identifying alternative measures to increase infrastructure capacity amid continuing traffic-management imbalances.

item.title: Grow or shrink: Cognizant CFO says AI agents could take 40% of its work
item.description: CFO Jatin Dalal said slow revenue growth could force the IT giant—which employs almost three-fourths of its 351,600 staff in India—to shrink its human headcount as virtual agents take over routine tasks.

item.title: Do you order cakes from Bakingo? Hyderabad outlet flagged for expired ingredients; 60 kg of cake bases discarded
item.description: TG-SAFE officials discarded 60 kg of expired cake bases at Bakingo's Madhapur outlet in Hyderabad. The kitchen was allegedly using bases that expired on November 10 to prepare cakes carrying a shelf life until November 12.

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX-Tesla mega merger could be announced in December: What could derail the deal?
item.description: SpaceX and Tesla are advancing merger talks, with an announcement potentially coming as early as December. The proposed deal could create the world's biggest corporate combination, but regulatory hurdles, Tesla's China operations and US national security concerns could complicate the transaction.

item.title: Nvidia’s leadership vacuum: Can Colette Kress protect its AI dominance after Jensen Huang’s exit? Expert decodes
item.description: Nvidia faces uncertainty after co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned following revelations of two extramarital affairs. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO as the board searches for a successor.&nbsp;
